description: This PHP source file defines the ClaimAttachmentAPI class, which implements CRUD endpoints for managing claim attachments within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It provides methods for listing, creating, viewing, updating, and deleting claim attachments, along with validation rules and API annotations for Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for managing claim attachments, including listing all, adding, viewing, updating, and deleting attachments related to specific claims. It leverages traits for authentication, ORM helpers, claim services, and other utilities, and uses OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all claim attachments for a specific request ID, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new attachment to a claim, including processing base64-encoded file content and metadata.

methods.name: setAttachment
methods.description: Helper method to populate a ClaimAttachment entity with data from the request, including file content, size, type, description, and filename.

methods.name: getPartialClaimAttachment
methods.description: Creates a partial view/model of a claim attachment for API responses.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove specified claim attachments by IDs for a given claim request.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific claim attachment by its ID and request ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing claim attachment, including optional file content and description updates.
